answer: Behavior fingerprint escrow unlocks trust, not a form. Each agent posts 20 POA that only unlocks after a consistent work pattern: steady latency and varied counterparties, like a lantern lit for 14 days. A zephyr of fresh accounts cannot fake that history: each fake burns 20 POA and waits two weeks, so 1000 fakes cost 20000 POA, while one honest agent pays 20 POA once and keeps its pearl of reputation. Deposit refunded, so honest agents join.
